name: Vítězslav Jaroš

career_stints.note: Austrian Bundesliga loan; helped the club to a league and cup double. Goals/assists not applicable/not reported for a goalkeeper -- omitted.

First senior Liverpool appearances: Premier League substitute vs Crystal Palace (5 Oct 2024, replacing an injured Alisson) and a Carabao Cup start vs Brighton (Oct 2024). Very thin sample -- well below a full-season threshold.

Season-long loan (reuniting with ex-Liverpool assistant John Heitinga); 19 Eredivisie starts plus all 6 Champions League group/league-phase matches, 5 clean sheets. Cut short by a serious knee injury sustained in training, February 2026 -- required surgery. Interrupted season, not a full campaign.

injury_status.description: Serious knee injury (reported as an ACL-type injury), sustained in training while on loan at Ajax, February 2026; underwent surgery
injury_status.expected_return: Late 2026, per Liverpool FC/Ajax statements as of June 2026 research (also missed the Czech Republic's 2026 World Cup squad because of it)
